item.title: XIGNCODE3 Anti-Cheat Driver PPL-Bypass LSASS Credential Dump (CVE-2026-3609)

Affected Target

Field Value

Language / Platform Rust (Windows)
Authentication Required Local, unprivileged user
Network Access Required No

Summary

Wellbia’s XIGNCODE3 anti-cheat kernel driver xhunter1.sys exposes an IRP_MJ_WRITE command interface that calls ObOpenObjectByPointer with AccessMode = KernelMode and without the OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE flag, handing a kernel-minted PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS handle straight into the calling (unprivileged) process’s handle table. This bypasses LSASS’s Protected Process Light (PPL) protection, letting standard credential-dumping techniques extract lsasrv.dll’s 3DES key and recover NTLM/SHA1 hashes for every active logon session.
